keyVerseDR: "And whosoever doth not carry his cross and come after me cannot be my disciple." (Lk 14:27)

level1.title: Jesus Comes First
level1.story: Big crowds followed Jesus. He said, "Whoever follows Me must carry their cross." He said to plan carefully, like a builder making a tower.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can Jesus come first today?
actions: Do a hard thing with love
level1.prayer: Jesus, You come first in my life. Amen.

activity.title: Build a tower
activity.intro: Plan carefully like the builder! Draw the other half of the house.

level2.title: The Cost of Discipleship
level2.story: Great crowds were traveling with Jesus, and He turned and said that whoever would be His disciple must love Him more than anyone. "And whosoever doth not carry his cross and come after Me, cannot be My disciple." He said that a man building a tower first sits down to count the cost. A king going to war first considers whether he can win. Jesus said, "Every one of you that doth not renounce all that he possesseth, cannot be My disciple."
level2.keyLine: Whosoever doth not carry his cross and come after me cannot be my disciple.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus want us to count the cost?
What might you need to put second to follow Jesus?
actions: Give up a distraction for prayer
level2.prayer: Jesus, I choose You above all. Amen.
